lines.say: Lexus once recalled every car it had sold. All eight thousand of them.
The problem? A cruise control thing and a brake light. Tiny stuff.
Dealers fixed it for free, left a loaner car, and washed the car before they brought it back.
People still point to that recall as part of why Lexus became a luxury brand.
So don't wait for the complaint. Text first. Was the last cut okay?
Comment KEEP and we'll show you who's gone quiet.
